item.title: Conference Presentations
item.description:
Below are selected academic conferences and seminars I have attended. Each entry records the presentation topic and its academic context. Conference photos, slides, and manuscripts can be added to the corresponding entry as materials become available.

National Interdisciplinary PhD Forum on Digital Economy 2022

Wuhan University, China · June 25, 2022 · Second Prize

Presented Customer Acquisition, Competition, and Promotion of Weak Products—A Theoretical Analysis. I prepared the presentation, presented the paper, answered audience questions, and incorporated feedback.
